description: Verify that DUT TCP includes exponential backoff for successive RTO values for SYN segments (RFC 1122 §4.2.3.1, RFC 6298 §5)
approach:
[Objective]
Same backoff requirement as RETRANSMISSION_TO_04 but for SYN retransmits during active OPEN.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT active OPEN → DUT → Tester: SYN.
2. Tester drops all SYNs.
3. DUT retransmits: syn_retx_1, _2, _3.
4. Observation: intervals strictly grow.

[Pass condition]
Intervals doubling.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_first_syn — initial SYN missing
• Fail_no_syn_retx_<n> — retransmit n missing
• Fail_initial_rto_out_of_window — first retx interval outside RFC 6298 initial window
• Fail_retx<n>_not_doubled — interval n not larger than n-1

verdicts.Fail_initial_rto_out_of_window: SYN retx 1 RTO out of RFC 6298 initial window
verdicts.Fail_retx2_not_doubled: SYN retx 2 delta not greater than initial RTO
verdicts.Fail_retx3_not_doubled: SYN retx 3 delta not greater than retx 2 lower bound
